UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
EXAMINATION TIME TABLE / SCHEDULE - CIVIL SERVICES (MAIN) EXAMINATION, 2026
AND INTERVIEW SCHEDULE (PERSONALITY TEST)

The Union Public Service Commission will conduct the Civil Services (Main) Examination, 2026 commencing from 18.09.2026.
Following the Mains Examination, the Personality Test (Interview) of candidates qualified in the written examination will commence from 15.01.2027.
Detailed e-Summon letters for Personality Test will be made available in due course.
